title: Progressive Validation Runway with Cohort Stoplight and Auto-Recovery
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a guarded, self-service A/B + shadow traffic framework that lets product and platform teams stage model versions through a progressive validation runway. Focus: per-tenant cohort stoplight gating, statistically sound sequential checks (both Bayesian and frequentist options), shadow-only runs, and automated rollback & recovery playbooks tied to runtime telemetry. The feature should: 1) let PMs/Engineers declare experiment signals and safety budgets; 2) support per-tenant thresholds and dual-metric gates (quality + SLO); 3) expose a console UX and API for scheduling, pausing, and aborting experiments; 4) integrate with runtime routing policies for gradual exposure (percent ramps, cohort pinning, rampback); and 5) implement an auto-rollback mechanism with human-in-the-loop notifications and automatic safe restore to previous model variant when thresholds are breached.
acceptance_criteria: Console: experiment creation wizard supports model variants, cohorts, ramp schedule, and primary/secondary signals
API: /experiments endpoints to create/update/pause/cancel experiments with per-tenant overrides
Runtime: routing policy that implements cohort stoplight (open/warn/closed) and supports immediate rollback command
Metrics: streaming evaluation pipeline captures per-request quality signals, latency, error-rate and exposes cohort-level aggregates within 1 minute
Statistical checks: configurable sequential test (Alpha-spending OBR/SPR) and optional Bayesian posterior probability checks; default policy documented
Shadow mode: ability to route 100% shadow traffic to new variant with zero impact on responses and collect diff metrics

Auto-rollback: policy engine triggers rollback when combined safety budget is exceeded (e.g., latency SLO degradation >5% AND drop in primary quality signal >3%), creates incident ticket, and notifies on-call channels
Audit & compliance: audit entries for experiment lifecycle events, and exportable CSV of evaluation results per cohort
E2E tests: automated test suite that validates ramping, gating, rollback and recovery scenarios in a staging environment
Security review: data handling and PII controls reviewed and signed off
